title: Zenso Plugin Manifest
description: Source of truth for the Zenso plugin manifest contract. Mirrored by zenso-api (zod) and zenso-panel (config form builder).

$schema.description: URL of the manifest schema this file conforms to.

id.description: Unique plugin identifier in owner/repo form, e.g. "zenso/zenso-plugin-calendar".

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in the panel.

description.description: Short description of what the plugin does.

thumbnail.description: Relative path to a preview image bundled with the plugin.

schema_version.description: Must match the schema major version in the URL.

capabilities.description: Runtime capabilities. Currently only "script" (allows bundled .js files).

config_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07) of the plugin instance configuration (configJson). Must declare type "object" and properties. Each property type must be renderable by the Zenso panel: string | number | boolean | array (optionally an array of objects).

properties.description: Map of config field name to field definition. Panel renders one form field per entry.

type.description: Field type. Rendered as text, number input, toggle, or dynamic list.

default.description: Pre-filled value shown in the panel form.

format.description: Value format hint. "uri" and "color" are rendered by the panel (color = native picker). Planned: date, time, datetime, email.

enum.description: Allowed values; renders as a dropdown.

format.description: Value format hint. "uri" and "color" are rendered by the panel (color = native picker).

properties.description: For object items: map of sub-field name to field definition (same shape as a top-level field).

required.description: Required sub-field keys for object items.

items.description: For arrays: the type of each list item. Use "object" to model a list of structured rows (e.g. calendar feeds with url + color).

required.description: Config field keys that must be present in configJson.

additionalProperties.description: Whether unknown configJson keys are allowed (default: false in JSON Schema).

config.description: Source-specific options, e.g. references to configJson field names (urls_field, days_ahead_field).
